text: Ten fictional nonprofit passages across the requested settings, each with eight quote variants for citation-checker testing.

passages.source_passage: Welcome to the case management module at Kalimba Ridge Camp, which has hosted about 14,000 people since 2019. As a volunteer, you will sit with families during intake interviews, but you will not make decisions about resettlement or legal status. Caseworkers review every file within five working days, and urgent protection concerns must be reported the same day. Never promise a family a particular outcome. If a child arrives alone, note the time, stay with them, and call the duty officer on the camp radio. Volunteers complete 12 hours of supervised practice before working independently, and 3 of those hours cover confidentiality.

variants.whitespace_case: CASEWORKERS review every file within five working days,  and urgent protection concerns must be reported the same  day.
variants.punctuation: Caseworkers review every file within five working days and urgent protection concerns must be reported the same day.

variants.added_negation: Volunteers do not complete 12 hours of supervised practice before working independently
variants.removed_negation: As a volunteer, you will sit with families during intake interviews, but you will make decisions about resettlement or legal status.
variants.reordered: If a child arrives alone, note the time, stay with them, and call the camp officer on the duty radio.
variants.paraphrase: When an unaccompanied child turns up, record when they arrived, remain beside them, and radio the officer on duty.

passages.source_passage: During the reporting period of January to June 2023, the Little Steps playgroup network in the Marrow Valley district ran 42 weekly sessions across nine villages. Average attendance was 27 children per session, up from 21 in the previous period. Facilitators did not complete the planned home-visit schedule, with only 58% of visits carried out because of flooding on the northern road. No playgroup closed permanently. Caregiver surveys show that two thirds of parents now read or sing with their child daily, although the baseline figure was never recorded for the three newest villages.

passages.source_passage: In 2022 the Sunrise Coast Net Campaign distributed 86,400 insecticide-treated bed nets to households in seven districts, reaching an estimated 94% of the target population. Distribution teams did not run out of stock at any point, but delivery to the two island districts was delayed by three weeks owing to ferry cancellations. Follow-up visits in November found that 78% of nets were hung correctly. Households told us they had never received instructions on washing the nets before this year. We therefore added a short demonstration to every collection point, and we plan to repeat the survey in March 2024.

variants.reordered: the Sunrise Coast Net Campaign distributed 86,400 insecticide-treated bed nets to districts in seven households
variants.paraphrase: Home checks carried out in November showed nearly four out of five nets had been put up properly.

passages.source_passage: Smallholder farmers in the Dunmere Plateau have faced four failed rainy seasons since 2018, and rainfall is no longer predictable enough for the maize varieties most households still plant. Roughly 35,000 families depend on rain-fed agriculture, yet fewer than one in ten has access to certified drought-tolerant seed. Previous extension efforts did not reach women farmers, who manage nearly 60% of plots but rarely attend demonstration days held at district offices. The proposed project will not replace local crops. Instead, it will introduce sorghum and cowpea trials on 120 farms during the first two seasons.

passages.source_passage: Across the Harbour Ridge region, about 31% of adults aged 18 and over cannot read a short text with understanding, according to the 2021 household survey. The Evening Pages network currently runs 64 classes in church halls and schools, but most learners work long days and cannot attend before six in the evening. Earlier pilots showed that classes without childcare did not retain women beyond the first term. Nobody in the network is paid a full salary, and instructors are not required to hold teaching qualifications. This proposal seeks funding for training, materials and a modest childcare stipend over three years.

variants.paraphrase: Early trials found that women left within the first term when a class offered no childcare.

passages.source_passage: Volunteers in the Koroma Primary Nutrition Programme serve a hot midday meal to 450 pupils every school day. Each portion should contain about 350 calories, and cooks must never reuse leftover porridge from the previous day. Wash your hands before handling food, and do not allow children to queue in the sun for more than ten minutes. If a pupil has no meal ticket, serve them anyway and tell the head teacher afterwards. Weigh the maize and beans every Friday, and record the stock in the blue book. Since the programme began in 2020, attendance has risen by 12%.

passages.source_passage: A village savings and loan group in the Tamba Hills scheme has between 15 and 25 members who meet every week. At each meeting, members buy shares worth 500 shillings each, and no member may buy more than five shares in a single session. The loan box has three locks, and the keys are never held by the same person. The group does not charge interest above 10% per month, and loans are not issued unless at least half the members are present. At the end of the 12-month cycle, savings and profits are shared out according to the number of shares each member holds. Facilitators should stress that the group belongs to its members.

passages.source_passage: At the mid-term point in March 2024, the Bayline Early Warning Programme had installed 18 siren towers along 210 kilometres of coastline, against a target of 25. Evaluators found that residents in 31 of 40 surveyed villages could name the evacuation route, but fewer than half had practised it. The programme did not meet its goal of testing every siren monthly, mainly because spare batteries were not available locally. No lives were lost in the October storm, although two community shelters were damaged. We recommend that the final eighteen months prioritise battery supply and drills for fishing households.

variants.paraphrase: Nobody died in the October storm, though a pair of shelters used by the community suffered damage.

passages.source_passage: The Anandpur Clinic Outreach Project, launched in 2022, aims to raise the proportion of mothers receiving four antenatal visits from 48% to 70% by 2025. At the mid-term review, the figure stood at 61%. Health workers visited 1,900 homes during the period, yet the evaluation found that no village had a trained birth attendant on call overnight. Mothers said that distance, not cost, was the main reason they skipped clinic appointments. The team did not collect data on newborn weight at birth in the first year, so the improvement in low-birthweight rates cannot be confirmed. Staff morale remains high, and the district health office has pledged to take over two outreach vans.

variants.punctuation: Mothers said that distance not cost was the main reason they skipped clinic appointments.
variants.changed_quantity: The Anandpur Clinic Outreach Project, launched in 2022, aims to raise the proportion of mothers receiving four antenatal visits from 48% to 80% by 2025.
variants.added_negation: Staff morale remains high, and the district health office has not pledged to take over two outreach vans.
variants.removed_negation: The team did collect data on newborn weight at birth in the first year
variants.reordered: Mothers said that cost, not distance, was the main reason they skipped clinic appointments.
variants.paraphrase: Mothers explained that they mainly missed clinic visits because the journey was too far, not because of the price.

passages.source_passage: Between April and September 2023, the Greenwell Borehole and Latrine Project completed 14 boreholes and 220 household latrines in the Okoro sub-county. Water committees were formed at every borehole site, but only 9 of the 14 committees have collected user fees as agreed. Three boreholes did not meet the minimum yield standard during the dry spell and were not handed over to the community. Latrine uptake is encouraging: households that built a latrine did not revert to open defecation in 85% of spot checks. Handwashing stations remain scarce, and soap was available at fewer than one in four of them.
